title: oven-roasted wood-fired dutch penne pasta
description: peppery, silky, weeknight dutch dish featuring penne pasta, wood-fired-bake, high-protein-friendly, vessel=comal
instructions: Preheat the comal or wood-fired oven to 450°F (230°C).
Place the penne pasta on a baking sheet and toss with 1 tablespoon of olive oil until coated.
In a large bowl, combine the chicken, onion, garlic, mushrooms, thyme, and black pepper. Mix well to combine.
Add the chicken broth to the bowl and toss to combine.
Place the chicken mixture on one half of the comal or baking sheet, leaving about 1 inch of space between the two halves.
Place the penne pasta on the other half of the comal or baking sheet.
Drizzle the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over the penne pasta.
Cover the comal or baking sheet with a lid or foil and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the lid or foil and stir the penne pasta.
Return the comal or baking sheet to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the penne pasta is al dente and the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the gouda cheese until melted and well combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the penne pasta to a serving dish and top with the chicken and mushroom mixture.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
Serve the penne pasta hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
